description: Header file for LibXDiff, a C library for file differencing and merging, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to diff and merge operations.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns pointer to the first data in a mmfile and its size.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the mmfile.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two memory-mapped files.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Merges three files: original, file1, and file2 into a result.
